about: Blanks a finished letter still has in it when it is about to leave the site: printed, or faxed to an insurance company.
One list for both sides. fighthealthinsurance/letter_placeholders.py reads it for the fax form on the server, and static/js/letter_placeholders.ts bundles it for the print and fax buttons.

Patterns are written in the part of regular expression syntax that Python's re (with re.ASCII) and JavaScript's RegExp read the same way: no lookbehind, no \s, no capturing groups. The only flag is i.
Text matched by an ignore pattern is never reported. Each placeholder pattern then claims what it matches, in order, so a later pattern never reports part of something an earlier one found.
A pattern here stops a fax, so each one is narrow on purpose: a citation like [1], a statute subsection like (a), an amount like $500 and a karyotype like 47,XXX all pass.

ignore.name: a karyotype, which is a diagnosis rather than a blank
